三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪同样偏空。技术因子统计显示，十五个因子中六个做多、八个做空、一个中性，做空因子占比百分之五十三点三，与比特币完全一致。复合指标给出做空信号，历史胜率为百分之七十一，空头优势明显。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why Being Able to Afford Losses Helps You Last Longer
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule everyone has heard a million times but 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should be no more than 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means you can lose at most 200 U on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few winning trades can get you back on track. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it just to break even—the math has basically already written you off.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you’d lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
is no more than 2%.” So the right order is: find your stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

One-line midday market recap: BTC hit a high of 80,999.9, just $0.1 short of 81,000. That kind of fixation is just like a retail trader whose limit order is always one cent off.

First, the main course. BTC is currently at 80,894, up 0.034% over 24 hours. Calling that a gain is a stretch—it’s more like a flattened ECG. But don’t roll your eyes just yet; there’s something in the details. After hitting an intraday low of 79,178.6, the price kept narrowing its range, repeatedly holding above the 80,404 pivot and staying above 79,618 on the pullback. Moving sideways without falling is an attitude in itself.

The funding rate is 0.00718%—positive, but barely awake. In plain English: leverage isn’t overheated, and sentiment hasn’t gone overboard. That makes an upward move feel more solid. What’s truly scary is when rates skyrocket amid a market-wide frenzy. Clearly, that’s not where we are now.

While BTC is hovering near its intraday high, ETH is still gasping for air around 2,342. The relative strength says it all about where the money is going. In the short term, watch 2,404. Outlook: leaning bullish. Three reasons: price is holding above the 80,404 pivot; the pullback to 79,618 held; and the intraday highs are rising. If it holds above the 81,000 area, watch for 81,630. After Ethereum switched to proof of stake, many blocks have been outsourced to professional builders for assembly via MEV-Boost, with validators selecting the highest-bidding block.
One thing that’s easy to overlook: on-chain transactions are usually publicly visible before they’re included in a block. Whoever can determine the order of transactions may be able to profit from them.
You can use a wallet with sandwich-attack protection or a private transaction channel to keep your transaction out of the public mempool.

Big Brother Maji’s $ETH  long position was liquidated again. This time, only 115 ETH remain

Early this morning on October 25, his 25x leveraged Ethereum long was completely liquidated, with net losses exceeding $180,000. He immediately re-entered the market with another long position, but now holds just 115 ETH, worth $269,000, with a liquidation price of $2,316.

Compare that with a week ago: after being liquidated on October 18, he re-entered with 1,325 ETH worth $3.2 million; on the 19th, he increased that to 2,350 ETH worth $5.7 million. From $5.7 million to $269,000—a 95% shrinkage in four days.

His cumulative losses have reached $36.88 million. The $44.84 million he made on Hyperliquid a little over a year ago has all been given back—and he’s now in the red.

This isn’t a story about even a big player losing money; it’s a live demonstration of leverage math. At 25x, a 4% move in the opposite direction wipes you out. Last night, ETH fell from $2,372 to $2,281—3.8%, almost exactly that threshold.

The number to watch now is his liquidation price: $2,316, versus the current price of $2,337—a gap of just 0.9%. Another $21 drop, and this position is gone too.

The market implications are even more direct: liquidation orders are stacked below $2,316. A break below that level could trigger a cascade of liquidations.

For trading, $2,316 is a key level for ETH. If it holds, watch $2,372; if it breaks, watch $2,281, then $2,250. Don’t chase longs or take on a heavy short position here—the wicks can take out both sides.

Leverage doesn’t amplify your judgment; it only amplifies the outcome 👀

translatedData.content:
Ethereum’s price has corrected by about 15% over the past three weeks, wiping roughly $54 billion off its market capitalization, while derivatives activity has cooled at the same time. According to data from analyst Darkfost cited by PANews, open interest in ETH futures on Binance fell by $1.3 billion over the past month, a decline of nearly 20%, to $5.7 billion. Total ETH open interest across the market dropped to $11.5 billion. My take: this round of deleveraging is worth watching, but it does not, by itself, mean the price has bottomed.

First, let’s look at what’s driving it. Darkfost attributes the deleveraging to three factors: falling prices, cascading liquidations, and traders voluntarily closing positions to reduce risk. These are different in nature: cascading liquidations involve forced selling, voluntary risk reduction means traders are choosing to withdraw their exposure, and falling prices also reduce the available margin buffer. Together, they point to the same outcome—lower open interest—but the causes differ, as do their implications. The information available does not specify the proportion attributable to each factor, so it’s impossible to tell which one is dominant. That is the key piece of evidence still missing.

Based on this, the immediate effect of deleveraging is to reduce the fuel for forced selling: with fewer leveraged positions, the chain of liquidations becomes shorter, lowering the risk of a sell-off accelerating due to forced closures. But note that this means only “less selling pressure,” not “more buying.” Falling open interest means capital is exiting or scaling back; it does not represent new demand. Reading deleveraging as a signal that a bottom is in confuses “the decline is slowing” with “a rally is coming.”

The comparison with July also calls for caution. The source notes that Ethereum saw a sharper contraction in open interest at the time, followed by stabilization and a rebound of more than 32%, with the price briefly breaking above $2,800. But this is just one historical example, cited by a single analyst, and does not justify assuming that the same pattern will repeat this time.

In my view, there are two conditions worth tracking to confirm a recovery: first, open interest needs to stop falling and start rising, suggesting that risk capital is returning rather than simply exiting; second, spot trading volume needs to increase alongside it, indicating genuine buying demand. Only if both occur can we talk about signs of stabilization. If open interest continues to contract while spot trading remains subdued, the more reasonable interpretation is that the correction is not over yet.

#ETH #CryptoMarket

Source:
PANews (originally published October 25 at 18:31 Beijing time)
https://www.panewslab.com/zh/articles/01a1729d-c586-7271-b829-7fe9a9bf0cef

content:
以太坊近三周价格回调约15%、市值缩水约540亿美元，衍生品同步降温。据PANews援引分析师Darkfost的数据，币安ETH未平仓合约一个月减少13亿美元、降幅接近20%，降至57亿美元，全网ETH未平仓合约降至115亿美元。我的判断是：这轮杠杆出清值得关注，但它本身不等于价格见底。

先看构成。Darkfost把去杠杆归因于价格下跌、连锁清算和交易者主动平仓降险三类因素。这三者性质不同：连锁清算是被迫卖出，主动降险是交易者自己撤掉风险敞口，价格下跌则同时压低保证金空间。它们共同指向同一结果——未平仓合约收缩，但收缩的成因不同，后续含义也不同。本次素材没有给出三者的具体占比，所以无法判断哪一类是主导，这是目前最需要补上的证据。

据此推断，去杠杆的直接作用是削弱强制抛售的燃料：杠杆仓位减少，连环清算的链条变短，市场因被动平仓而加速下跌的压力会下降。但要注意，这只是“卖压变小”，不是“买盘变多”。未平仓合约下降意味着有资金离场或收缩，它不构成新增需求。把去杠杆直接读成筑底，是把“跌得没那么急”误当成“要涨了”。

7月的类比也需要谨慎。素材提到，以太坊当时经历更剧烈的未平仓合约收缩，随后企稳反弹，涨幅超过32%，价格一度突破2800美元。这只是一次单一历史样本，且由单一分析师提出，不能据此推断本轮会重演。

我的观察是，真正值得跟踪的验证条件有两个：一是未平仓合约止跌回升，说明风险资金重新进场而非单纯撤离；二是现货成交同步放大，说明有真实买盘承接。两者同时出现，才谈得上企稳信号；若未平仓合约继续收缩而现货成交低迷，更合理的解读仍是调整尚未走完。

Looking at the past 24 hours today, we’re down 1.4%; over the past week, down 3.6%. I don’t have the exact figures from a month ago, so I won’t make them up. The worst thing in this market is pretending to know what’s going on and spinning a story with numbers you don’t have.

The incident at Initia really stands out: L1 and the rollup have been paused, and researchers discovered unauthorized minting. More than $2.6 million in assets was transferred to Ethereum. ETH itself wasn’t attacked, but the exposure did reach the chain. We can’t just pretend this didn’t happen.

So, who actually pays? Initia users, holders of related assets, and protocol funds bear the losses first. The business logic is simple: protocols collect fees and provide services. Once security fails, even impressive-looking returns are just numbers on paper.

The impact on ETH is mainly about sentiment, not technology. The FGI is at 54, with a weekly average of 57. The market hasn’t entered panic mode, which suggests this incident hasn’t triggered a sell-off—for now. But if security incidents keep happening, the ETH ecosystem will have to pay a higher risk premium. Trading volume is still active, and tokens are changing hands, but there’s no clear direction yet. This is when it’s easiest to talk a cautious game while getting itchy trigger fingers.

I learned my lesson back in 2017 from projects that claimed “nothing is wrong.” The way they fleece you hasn’t changed; only the packaging does. These days, I care more about who bears the losses and who ultimately collects the fees.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | The Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Drama from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script for every market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt: Prices rise for a few days, but no one believes it. Everyone says it’s just a rebound and time to sell.
② Acceptance: Prices hit a new high, analysts turn bullish, and retail investors tentatively get in.
③ Excitement: Prices keep surging, people in group chats start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is soaring.
⑤ Denial: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy correction—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic: Prices plunge day after day, and people rush to sell at a loss—yet this is where the seeds of the next cycle are planted.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What’s the Fuel Cost of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay a Gas fee to transfer funds, and you pay a Gas fee to mint an NFT. Who does that money go to?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer, and every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who help execute those computations.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network gets, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain transactions late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

By improving research efficiency, AI could help bring more fundamental research findings to market, benefiting tech companies with high computing needs. Rising demand for AI computing power could also indirectly benefit related tokens. But in the short term, the impact is unclear. Let me make my stance clear upfront: I won’t chase a short-term ETH rebound. Whether institutional funds resume sustained inflows is more worth watching than a single bullish candle. Farside’s table of U.S. spot Ethereum funds shows combined net outflows of about $110.6 million on October 22, including $75.5 million from ETHA and $17.2 million from ETHB. The table’s automatic total for October 23 shows an inflow of $4.4 million, but the ETHV column still contains a dash, so the data is incomplete; this shouldn’t be spun as “funds have broadly shifted to inflows.” I treat the former as a historical fund-flow figure that has been reported, and the latter as an observation that still needs to be completed. I’ll wait for an update from the fund issuer or summary page before making a judgment.

Why does this matter for ETH? Spot fund creations and redemptions affect expectations for marginal demand through regulated channels, and also shape how the market assesses the sustainability of institutional allocations. But fund net flows aren’t a real-time record of every spot trade, and a single day’s total shouldn’t be taken as a direct signal for the direction of ETH’s next candle. Spot markets are still fluctuating over the weekend, while U.S. equity funds aren’t trading, so we shouldn’t force a causal link between Friday’s missing data and weekend prices. Binance Square’s trending topics right now include macroeconomics, regulation, and altcoin rebounds, but there’s no tag that directly matches this ETH fund data. title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

title: Jiang Zhuoer: Bitcoin's Biggest Risk Is "Having No Use" — Q-Day as Turning Point
subTitle:
Jiang Zhuoer, founder of BTC.TOP and LaiBit Mining Pool, one of the largest

Bitcoin mining operations in China, asserts that Bitcoin's most significant long-term risk is not related to price volatility or threats from quantum computing, but rather its lack of practical use. 

He explains that without a use case, Bitcoin does not have the same foundational demand as gold, which is used industrially, or Ethereum, which supports smart contracts and decentralized applications.

Instead, Bitcoin’s value is primarily driven by a community belief that it is valuable, creating a loop where people buy it because they perceive it as valuable, and it's considered valuable because people are buying it. 

Zhuoer also points out that the gains from Bitcoin have diminished with each market cycle.

 If Bitcoin fails to consistently outperform major indices like the Nasdaq, he anticipates that holders will start to sell, leading to potential negative consequences for the market. 

Currently, Zhuoer is exclusively holding Ethereum, as he considers it the superior global computing platform. 

He believes that as real-world applications of blockchain technology increase, the mechanisms of Ethereum will generate significant value through fee-burning.

Regarding the concept of Q-Day, a date predicted to occur when quantum computers could potentially compromise current encryption methods, Zhuoer sees this event as a pivotal moment for the market.

He believes that while quantum attacks pose a limited technical threat to Bitcoin, Q-Day will likely shift the conversation towards which blockchain will provide genuine utility in a post-quantum world.

Zhuoer previously divested his entire Bitcoin holdings at $82,050 and subsequently repurchased 75% of his position at $82,789, achieving a cumulative profit of 98.6% in U.S. dollar terms, which has drawn attention from the market. 

The discussion surrounding the need for Bitcoin to establish real-world use versus being viewed merely as a store of value is, once again, a significant topic within the cryptocurrency community.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being Flat Is a Position Too—and It’s the One Experienced Traders Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly entering and exiting positions,
and fees and market swings slowly eat away their capital.

In reality, being flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay flat.
In a market where bulls and bears are battling, staying flat—and staying flat after a few consecutive losing trades—the money you save in these three situations
is more than most trades earn.

You may be tired of the hunting analogy, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes only a second. With capital on hand, you’ll have ammunition when an opportunity comes. Hold on to your ammunition.

I. Price Trend Analysis

Ethereum performed weaker than Bitcoin today. Its price continued to fall from $2,368, reaching a low of $2,318, and is currently trading at around $2,339. Over the past 24 hours, Ethereum has fallen by approximately 1.35%, a significantly larger decline than Bitcoin’s. On the hourly candlestick chart, the last five candles have all closed lower, showing a clear one-way downward trend.

Specifically, the first candle opened at $2,368 and closed at $2,353. The second continued lower, reaching $2,340. The third saw a slight rebound to $2,347. The fourth fell again to $2,335. The latest candle accelerated downward, closing at $2,325. The bodies of the five candles gradually narrowed, but their centers continued to move lower, indicating strong control by sellers and limited resistance from buyers.

Trading volume increased somewhat during the decline. Trading value in the fourth period reached $13.58 million, the highest of the past five periods, indicating a notable degree of panic selling. On-chain data shows net spot outflows of more than $106 million over two hours, with large trades accounting for over 54%, suggesting that whale funds are accelerating their exit. Reports indicate that a large whale reduced its holdings by more than 8,000 ETH in the short term, worth over $18 million.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving average system is broadly bearish. The 7-day moving average is at $2,347, the 25-day moving average at $2,349, and the 99-day moving average at $2,402. The current price is below all moving averages, and the short-term averages have started to turn downward, forming the early stages of a bearish alignment. The exponential moving averages are also signaling bearishness: the 7-period EMA is at $2,342, the 25-period EMA at $2,353, and the 99-period EMA at $2,386.

The Bollinger Bands show the upper band at $2,377, the middle band at $2,344, and the lower band at $2,311. The price has fallen below the middle band and is approaching the lower band. The Bollinger Bands are showing signs of widening, suggesting there may be further downside ahead.

As for the MACD, the DIF line is at -7.38, the DEA line at -6.53, and the histogram at -0.86. The MACD is below the zero line, and the histogram has turned from positive to negative, indicating that bearish momentum is strengthening. The 6-period RSI has fallen to 26.81, entering oversold territory. The 12-period RSI is 35.33, and the 24-period RSI is 38.96; RSI readings across all periods are relatively low.

The KDJ indicator shows a K value of 27.04, a D value of 44.53, and a J value of -7.94. The Williams %R has fallen to -86.25, and the Stochastic RSI has dropped to 14.84; both are in deeply oversold territory. Historical patterns suggest that when multiple oversold indicators are triggered at the same time, a short-term technical rebound is more likely. However, it is worth noting that the Parabolic SAR has flipped above the price, sitting near $2,370 and forming a short-term resistance level.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum is currently facing multiple headwinds. First, macroeconomic uncertainty continues to build: geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and the approaching Federal Reserve interest rate decision are causing capital to take a more defensive stance overall. Second, negative news has emerged from the DeFi ecosystem. The X100 protocol suffered a governance attack, resulting in losses of approximately $4.85 million and undermining confidence in the security of the Ethereum ecosystem. In addition, well-known trader Arthur Hayes has liquidated large positions in ETH and several other altcoins, further deepening bearish sentiment.

On the positive side, Ethereum’s staking rate has reached a record high, with approximately 36% of ETH staked. This has reduced the circulating supply to some extent, providing a degree of support for the price. Factor statistics show that 11 of 15 technical factors are signaling a buy, a share as high as 73.3% and clearly above Bitcoin’s 60%. The historical win rate for the composite indicators is 74%, with an average maximum return of 0.79%, outperforming Bitcoin’s 0.47%.

This suggests that although Ethereum’s short-term trend is weak, its potential for a medium-term rebound may be greater. Conservative investors can watch the strength of support around $2,300. If the price stabilizes in this area and rebounds on rising volume, a technical recovery rally may follow. Aggressive investors should wait for clearer reversal signals, such as the MACD histogram turning from negative to positive or the price moving back above the 7-day moving average.

content:
一、价格走势分析

以太坊今日表现弱于比特币，价格从两千三百六十八美元持续下行，最低触及两千三百一十八美元，当前报价约为两千三百三十九美元。过去二十四小时内，以太坊累计下跌约百分之一点三五，跌幅明显大于比特币。从小时K线来看，最近五根K线全部收阴，呈现出单边下行的走势格局。

具体来看，第一根K线开盘两千三百六十八美元，收于两千三百五十三美元。第二根继续走低至两千三百四十美元。第三根出现小幅反弹至两千三百四十七美元。第四根再次下跌至两千三百三十五美元。最新一根K线加速下行，收于两千三百二十五美元。五根K线的实体逐步缩小但重心不断下移，表明空方控盘力度较强，多方抵抗力度有限。

成交量方面，下跌过程中成交量有所放大。第四个时段成交额达到一千三百五十八万美元，为近五个时段最高，显示恐慌性抛售情绪较为明显。链上数据显示，两小时内现货净流出超过一亿零六百万美元，其中超过百分之五十四为大单交易，说明鲸鱼资金正在加速离场。据报道，大型鲸鱼在短期内减持超过八千枚ETH，价值超过一千八百万美元。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统全面看空。七日均线位于两千三百四十七美元，二十五日均线位于两千三百四十九美元，九十九日均线位于两千四百零二美元。当前价格运行在所有均线下方，且短期均线已经开始向下拐头，形成空头排列的雏形。指数移动平均线同样发出看空信号，七周期EMA为两千三百四十二美元，二十五周期EMA为两千三百五十三美元，九十九周期EMA为两千三百八十六美元。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于两千三百七十七美元，中轨位于两千三百四十四美元，下轨位于两千三百一十一美元。价格已经跌破中轨并向下轨靠近，布林带有开口扩大的趋势，暗示后续可能还有进一步的下行空间。

MACD指标方面，DIF线为负七点三八，DEA线为负六点五三，柱状图为负零点八六。MACD在零轴下方运行，且柱状图由正转负，空方动能正在增强。RSI六周期指标降至二十六点八一，已经进入超卖区域，十二周期RSI为三十五点三三，二十四周期RSI为三十八点九六，各周期RSI均处于偏低水平。

KDJ指标中，K值为二十七点零四，D值为四十四点五三，J值为负七点九四。威廉指标降至负八十六点二五，随机RSI指标降至十四点八四，均处于深度超卖区域。从历史经验来看，当多个超卖指标同时触发时，短期内出现技术性反弹的概率较高。不过需要注意的是，抛物线SAR指标已经翻转到价格上方，位于两千三百七十美元附近，形成了短期的压力位。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多重压力。首先，宏观层面的不确定性持续发酵，中东地缘政治紧张和美联储利率决议的临近，使得资金整体偏向防御。其次，DeFi生态传来负面消息，X100协议遭遇治理攻击，损失约四百八十五万美元，打击了市场对以太坊生态安全的信心。此外，知名交易员Arthur Hayes大规模清仓ETH等多个山寨币持仓，进一步加剧了市场的悲观情绪。

不过从积极的一面来看，以太坊质押率已经达到历史新高，约百分之三十六的ETH处于质押状态，这在一定程度上减少了流通供给，为价格提供了一定的底部支撑。从因子统计来看，十五个技术因子中有十一个发出做多信号，占比高达百分之七十三点三，明显高于比特币的百分之六十。综合指标的历史胜率为百分之七十四，平均最大回报率为百分之零点七九，优于比特币的百分之零点四七。

这表明虽然以太坊短期走势偏弱，但中期反弹的潜力可能更大。对于稳健型投资者而言，当前可以关注两千三百美元附近的支撑力度，若价格能够在此区域企稳并放量反弹，则可能迎来一波技术性修复行情。激进型投资者则需等待更明确的反转信号，如MACD柱状图由负转正或价格重新站上七日均线。

今日热门代币方面，T代币当前价格为零点零零六七美元，二十四小时涨幅达到百分之四十五点三四。XEC代币报价零点零零零零零七二七美元，涨幅为百分之十二点八九。POLYX代币价格为零点零三六九美元，涨幅为百分之七点八九。

title: 交易心理 | 比预测行情更重要的事：复盘你自己的单子
subTitle:
大部分人花90%的时间预测行情，花0%的时间复盘自己。方向反了。

每笔单子记三行字：为什么开（依据是什么）、哪里错/对（执行层面）、
下次怎么改（具体动作）。坚持一个月，你会震惊地发现：你亏损的
单子里有大量「同一类错误」在反复出现——比如总是止损后立刻反手、
总是盈利单拿不住。

行情会变，但你的行为模式不会自动变，除非你盯着它改。市场是最
诚实的老师，你的交割单就是成绩单。别只看账户余额，去翻交易记录。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses…
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing direction immediately after a stop-loss,
or never letting winning trades run.

Market conditions change, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

UNITREE surged today. Here’s my short setup.

4-hour chart structure:
The August high was 130, followed by a steady drop to the 60s, where it consolidated for two months.
Today it broke out on heavy volume. Current price: 95.47; high: 96.68.

It looks strong.
But my view is that this is a shorting opportunity, not a chance to chase longs.

━━ Why I’m considering a short ━━

First, this looks like a structural rebound.
The 60–80 consolidation range is packed with historical bagholders.
Many trapped longs are waiting to break even, creating heavy selling pressure between $95 and $105.
This rally is bringing those bagholders back to the market, not kicking off a new trend.

Second, the data doesn’t support a trend-following long.
Current LSR: 69.8% shorts, only 30.2% longs.
Smart money is already shorting while retail traders are chasing longs.
FR = 0%, which means this rally has no support from funding rates.

Third, volume confirms the picture.
Today’s trading volume is 9M, notably lower than during past sharp rallies.
A rally without volume is far more likely to be distribution than a genuine breakout.

━━ Short strategy ━━

Entry zone: Around $105 (wait for a rebound; don’t chase the current price)
Stop loss: $111.6 (invalidation level; a breakout above this means my view is wrong)
Target 1: $95 (the former upper boundary of the consolidation range)
Target 2: $80.6 (the midpoint of the consolidation range)

The current price is still 9% below my entry zone.

If price doesn’t return to $105 and instead breaks above $111.6—

If the opportunity comes, I’ll take it. If not, I won’t.

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can't, don't enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position. Don't average down—ever.
4. After three losses in a row, stop trading for the day. Watch, but don't act.
5. Withdraw part of your profits. What you take out is money; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

Just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market; it's that their execution fell apart. Let's keep each other accountable.

Using less leverage, keeping more margin in reserve, and setting stop-losses in advance are the most common ways to avoid liquidation.

translatedData.content:
ETH Client Performance Proposal | 16 MB Cache Proposed for Short-Input Hashing | Don’t Chase Expectations Near 2330

I’m optimistic about the long-term significance of engineering improvements, but I’m not treating developers’ benchmark tests today as a buy signal for ETH. Proposal #36009 for Ethereum execution client Geth was submitted on October 24. It proposes setting a fixed 16 MB cache for Keccak256 hashes with shorter inputs. The proposal is still open, review by code owners is pending, and the page explicitly says it has not been deployed. This is a discussion about optimizing client implementation—not a change to consensus rules, and certainly not evidence that mainnet throughput has increased or gas fees have fallen.

The author posted retests on their own machine on the proposal page: using 2,000 historical blocks and running each group three times, the average time to process new block payloads fell from about 59.3 milliseconds to 56.7 milliseconds, roughly 4.4% faster; throughput rose from 464.0 to 483.1 MGas/s, about 4.1% higher. These figures describe a specific sample, hardware setup, and comparison baseline; they cannot be extrapolated to mean that network-wide TPS has increased by 4.1%. In the same table, improvement in the tail metric p99 is unclear, and some state reads even regressed slightly. If future review finds cache collisions, excessive memory usage, or inconsistent benefits across different workloads, the proposal could be revised or remain at the discussion stage. Geth’s official release page currently lists version 1.17.10 and does not describe this pending proposal as a live-network capability.

Why is it worth watching? Execution clients process transactions, execute contracts, and validate blocks, so their efficiency affects node operating costs and headroom under heavy loads. But ETH’s market price is also influenced by dollar liquidity, ETF flows, risk appetite, and actual on-chain demand. A local benchmark for a single client may not translate into network-wide revenue or a higher token price. Farside shows net outflows of about $110.6 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on October 22. The October 23 total is provisionally slightly positive, but the ETHV column is still blank, so it’s too soon to declare a broad return of institutional capital. Development updates and fund-flow data each need to be verified on their own merits.

The market has already responded more cautiously: at the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,332, with a 24-hour open near $2,356, a high near $2,370, and a low near $2,280. The current price is below the open, and there is still no evidence of a sustained, high-volume rally driven by this proposal. I’m watching the rolling low near $2,280, the current price near $2,330, and the upper range near $2,370. These are levels to monitor, not guaranteed support for a rebound. A move back above $2,370 followed by a successful retest would soften my bearish view; if price breaks below $2,280 decisively and fails to recover, protecting capital takes priority.

If I were trading this myself, I’d stay out for now, remain directionally neutral, and hold an actual position of 0%. Only if spot price reclaims $2,370, holds on a retest, and volume increases would I consider testing a spot long with no more than 2% of total capital. Until then, there is no trade and no profit. The first target is $2,410 and the second is $2,460. At the first target, I’d take half off and move the stop on the remaining position to around breakeven. I’d place the initial stop below $2,320; I’d also exit proactively if price quickly falls back below $2,330 after a breakout or if the proposal is withdrawn. If price first breaks below $2,280, I’d cancel the long setup and avoid both heavy dip-buying and high-leverage bets. Research can start early; positions must wait for confirmation.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH客户端性能提案｜短输入哈希拟设16MB缓存｜2330附近不追预期

我的态度是看好工程优化的长期意义，但今天不把开发者的基准测试当成ETH买入信号。以太坊执行客户端Geth的36009号提案于10月24日提出，方案是为较短输入的Keccak256哈希设一个固定16MB缓存。提案仍为Open，代码所有者的审阅尚在等待，页面也明确显示未部署。这是客户端实现层的优化讨论，不是共识规则已经改变，更不是主网吞吐或Gas费已下降。

作者在提案页面贴出自有机器的复测：取2000个历史区块、每组跑三次，处理新区块载荷的平均时间从约59.3毫秒降到56.7毫秒，约快4.4%；吞吐指标从464.0升到483.1 MGas/s，约高4.1%。这些数字描述特定样本、硬件和比较基线，不能外推成全网TPS增加4.1%。同一表里尾部指标p99改善并不明确，部分状态读取甚至有小幅退化。若未来审查发现缓存碰撞、内存占用或不同负载收益不稳定，方案完全可能修改或停留在讨论阶段。Geth正式发布页目前列出的1.17.10也没有把这项待审提案说成现网能力。

为什么值得关注？执行客户端处理交易、执行合约和校验区块的效率，关系到节点运行成本与高负载时的余量。但ETH的市场定价还受美元流动性、ETF资金、风险偏好和链上真实需求影响，单个客户端的本地基准未必能转化为全网收入或币价上涨。Farside显示10月22日美国ETH现货基金约净流出1.106亿美元，10月23日汇总暂为小幅正值，但其中ETHV栏仍为空，不能宣布机构资金全面回流。研发事实和资金事实都需要各自核对。

市场已经给了更冷静的反馈：写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2332美元，24小时开盘约2356、最高约2370、最低约2280，现价低于开盘，尚看不到因为这项提案而持续放量上冲的证据。我关注2280附近的滚动低点、2330附近的现价和2370附近的上沿；这些是观察位置，不是保证反弹的支撑。若重回2370上方并能回踩站稳，偏弱判断才会松动；若有效跌破2280后无法收回，继续保护本金优先。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向中性，实际仓位0%。只在现货重新站稳2370、回踩不破且成交增加时，考虑以总资金最多2%试探现货多单；触发前没有成交，也没有利润。首目标2410，第二目标2460，触及首目标先减仓一半，剩余仓位把止损抬到成本附近；初始止损放在2320下方，若突破后迅速跌回2330或提案被撤回，也主动平仓。若先跌穿2280，取消多单计划，不做重仓抄底和高杠杆押注。研究可以提前，仓位必须等验证。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: 周日傍晚：8 万附近横着，资金其实更「挑」
subTitle:
周日傍晚：8 万附近横着，资金其实更「挑」

周日下午到傍晚，公开行情里 BTC 大致在约 8.04 万附近晃（24 小时约 -0.4%），白天高点摸过约 8.10 万，周末低点仍在约 7.92 万那一带。早盘「跌破又收回」的戏码，到傍晚更像变成：整数位附近横盘，波动收窄。

真正拉开差距的是结构，不是大饼本身：
- ETH 更软一点（约 2335，近 24 小时约 -1.5%）
- SOL 也偏弱（约 100.8，约 -1.2%）
- 相对更有弹性的是 BNB（约 739，约 +0.7%）和 XRP（约 1.29，约 +1%）

所以盘面读起来不像「全面风险偏好回暖」，更像周末流动性偏薄下的「挑着买」：大饼在扛整数位，高 beta 里 ETH/SOL 仍在掉队，个别标的反而相对抗跌。

我个人怎么看这个周日傍晚（仅观察，非投资建议）：

1. 早盘收回 8 万，不等于傍晚已经确认支撑——价格横着，更要看成交和分化有没有改善；目前 ETH 仍弱于 BTC，说明风险偏好还没「整队」。
2. BNB、XRP 相对更稳，容易让人误读成「山寨回来了」；更稳妥的读法是结构性分化，而不是系统性加仓信号。
3. 接下来真正的考验仍在美东周日晚间期货重开之后：若美股影子价偏软，周末币圈这点横盘往往先被打乱；若期货平稳，才有资格讨论 8 万能不能从「反复试探」变成「站稳」。

你怎么看：现在更像「大饼护盘、山寨各走各的」，还是傍晚横盘只是周一开盘前的安静？评论区聊聊。

Let me tell you the truth: why can some people turn 5,000U into 50,000U in a month, while others lose down to 500U in a day?
#ETH 
The difference isn’t the market. It’s whether they treat leverage as a tool or a gambling table.

A lot of people think the higher the leverage, the easier it is to get liquidated. That’s not actually true.

What really gets you liquidated has never been 20x or 50x leverage.

It’s using high leverage and still insisting on taking a huge position.

Here’s a simple example. Say you want to take a 5,000U position.

Opening a 500U position at 10x and a 250U position at 20x both put 5,000U to work.

If the market rises 1%, you’ll make about the same amount either way.

But if the market falls 1%:

At 10x, a 500U position loses just 50U—10% of your margin.

At 20x, a 250U position also loses 50U, but that’s already 20% of your margin.

One more move like that, and you’ll lose your nerve.

So a lot of people don’t lose because of the market.

They lose because they don’t know how to size their positions.

If you have 10,000U in your account,

using 1,000U at 10x means you can only take 10 positions.

But if you use 500U at 20x, you can split it into 20 positions.

With the same amount of money, the latter approach is actually more flexible and safer.

Because the real purpose of high leverage isn’t to go all in on one trade.

It’s to let you trade small, take more opportunities, and enter in stages.

If you’re right, add to the position.

If you’re wrong, get out.

Low leverage suits people who take large positions and can withstand volatility.

High leverage suits people who trade small and get in and out quickly.

Use the approach that fits your style.

Don’t see someone make a fortune on one 50x trade and rush in yourself.

You see the one trade where they made money—you don’t see the ten trades where they blew up before that.

In the end, trading isn’t about who has the most courage.

It’s about who can stay steady.

Steady position sizing, steady stop-losses, steady execution. #AltcoinRecovery?

And I’ve also seen people grow 5,000U step by step into 200,000U.

The difference isn’t skill.

It’s that the first group uses leverage to gamble, while the second treats leverage as a tool.

Taishou won’t teach you to risk everything to make a comeback. I’ll teach you how to stay at the table.

The people who truly make money aren’t the ones who dare to use the most leverage, but the ones who know how to survive the longest.

translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their money in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12x over 250 trading days; earning a steady 10% a month adds up to
30x over three years. It doesn’t sound exciting, but there’s something remarkable about it—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for, while discipline is yours to control. Don’t make your goal
“double your money this week”; make it “make no major mistakes this week.” The money in the first goal comes from the market,
while the ability behind the second is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital earn the right to keep playing.

A Broad Look at the Ethereum Market: The Battle Around $2,300 and Ecosystem Concerns

I. Price Action Analysis

Ethereum trended lower in a choppy market over the past 24 hours. The price retreated from a high of $2,368, hit a low of $2,336, and ultimately closed near $2,346, down about 1.4% over 24 hours. While this decline may seem modest, ETH has repeatedly failed to break through the $2,400 resistance level, indicating heavy selling pressure overhead.

On the hourly candlestick chart, the price found short-term support near $2,340, but the rebound was limited. Trading volume expanded noticeably as prices fell, peaking at around $13 million, while volume contracted during the rebound. This divergence between price and volume suggests that bears remain in control.

Notably, Ethereum is currently trading below all major moving averages. The 7-day exponential moving average is $2,351, the 25-day moving average is $2,356, and the 99-day moving average is as high as $2,388. The price is about $40 below the long-term moving average. Such a wide gap typically means either that the price may move back toward the average or that the average may adjust downward.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving average system shows a clear bearish alignment. Short-term averages are diverging downward, long-term averages remain in a downtrend, and the price is held below the moving average system. This technical pattern typically occurs during a downtrend and indicates an overall bearish market.

As for the Relative Strength Index (RSI), the 6-period reading is 41.26, the 12-period reading is 43.92, and the 24-period reading is 43.52. All three readings are below 50, and the 6-period RSI is approaching the oversold zone around 40. While the market is not yet extremely oversold, its sustained weakness shows that bullish momentum is insufficient.

The MACD indicator shows a DIFF line at -4.96, a DEA line at -6.14, and a histogram reading of 1.18. Although MACD remains below the zero line, the histogram is positive and relatively stable, suggesting that downward momentum has eased somewhat. If the DIFF line crosses above the DEA line to form a golden cross, it could signal a short-term rebound.

For the Bollinger Bands, the upper band is $2,380, the middle band is $2,346, and the lower band is $2,313. The price is trading near the middle band, and the band width is relatively stable, indicating that the market is consolidating.

The KDJ indicator shows signs of oversold conditions. The K value is 39.73, the D value is 55.29, and the J value is just 8.61. The J value has fallen deep into oversold territory, a level that has often been followed by technical rebounds. However, in a strong downtrend, the KDJ indicator may remain oversold for an extended period.

The Williams %R (WR) reading is -68.85, in oversold territory. The indicator has remained below -50 for several consecutive periods, confirming the current weak market conditions.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

The Ethereum market is currently facing multiple sources of pressure. Of the 15 technical factors tracked, 9 are giving sell signals (60%), 5 are giving buy signals (33.33%), and 1 is neutral. The combined indicators show a historical win rate of 73.81% for sell signals. Although this is below BTC’s 80%, it still suggests that bears have the upper hand.

On the capital flows front, risk-reduction by large whale accounts has had a significant impact on the market. Net outflows of more than $100 million were recorded within two hours, sending the price tumbling from $2,367 to $2,306. Such concentrated withdrawals of large sums not only put direct downward pressure on prices but may also trigger panic selling by other investors.

Negative developments across the ecosystem are also a concern. The delayed deployment of the Glamsterdam testnet has undermined confidence in Ethereum’s upgrade progress. The testnet was originally intended to validate two major improvements to gas calculation, EIP-8037 and EIP-8038, but was postponed because of technical issues. While this will not affect mainnet operations, it delays Ethereum’s progress toward more efficient and cheaper transactions.

DeFi security incidents have further heightened market concerns. The X100 protocol suffered a governance attack in which the attacker used flash loans to obtain two Senate seats, then manipulated the token price to steal approximately $4.85 million in USDT. The incident exposed potential vulnerabilities in on-chain governance mechanisms and could undermine users’ trust in DeFi protocols.

On the positive side, Bitmine has staked an additional 159,728 ETH, worth about $390 million, with the goal of reaching 5% of Ethereum’s total supply. This institutional-scale staking provides some support for the market and limits the scope for further price declines.

Overall, Ethereum may continue trading sideways between $2,300 and $2,400 in the short term. A break above $2,400 will require strong fundamental support and capital inflows, while a fall below $2,300 could trigger a deeper correction. Investors should closely monitor testnet developments, ETF fund flows, and DeFi security conditions, and carefully assess the risk-reward balance.

以太坊市场全景观察：两千三百美元关口的攻防战与生态隐忧

一、价格走势分析

以太坊在过去二十四小时内呈现震荡下行态势，价格从两千三百六十八美元的高点回落，最低触及两千三百三十六美元，最终收于两千三百四十六美元附近，二十四小时跌幅约百分之一点四。这一跌幅虽然看似不大，但结合前期走势来看，ETH已经多次尝试突破两千四百美元阻力位未果，显示上方抛压沉重。

从小时级别K线分析，价格在两千三百四十美元附近获得了短期支撑，但反弹力度有限。成交量数据显示，在价格下跌过程中成交量明显放大，最高达到一千三百万美元级别，而反弹时成交量萎缩，这种量价背离暗示空头仍占据主导地位。

值得注意的是，以太坊价格目前运行在所有主要均线下方。七日指数均值为两千三百五十一美元，二十五日均线为两千三百五十六美元，九十九日均线更是高达两千三百八十八美元。价格与长期均线之间存在约四十美元的差距，这种较大的偏离度通常意味着要么价格将向均线回归，要么均线将向下修正。

二、技术指标解读

移动平均线系统呈现明显的空头排列。短期均线向下发散，长期均线保持下行趋势，价格被压制在均线系统下方。这种技术形态通常出现在下跌趋势中，表明市场整体偏空。

相对强弱指标方面，RSI六周期为四十一点二六，十二周期为四十三点九二，二十四周期为四十三点五二。三个周期的RSI均处于五十以下，且六周期RSI接近四十的超卖区域。虽然尚未进入极端超卖，但持续的弱势运行显示多头力量不足。

MACD指标显示，DIFF线为负四点九六，DEA线为负六点一四，柱状图为一点一八。MACD虽然仍处于零轴下方，但柱状图保持正值且相对稳定，暗示下跌动能有所减弱。如果DIFF线能够向上穿越DEA线形成金叉，可能为短期反弹提供信号。

布林带指标中，上轨为两千三百八十美元，中轨为两千三百四十六美元，下轨为两千三百一十三美元。价格在中轨附近运行，带宽相对稳定，表明市场处于震荡整理阶段。

KDJ指标显示超卖迹象。K值为三十九点七三，D值为五十五点二九，J值仅为八点六一。J值已经深入超卖区域，历史上这种极端低位往往伴随着技术性反弹。但需要注意的是，在强势下跌趋势中，KDJ指标可能长时间停留在超卖区域。

威廉指标WR为负六十八点八五，处于超卖区域。该指标连续多个周期保持在负五十以下，确认了当前的弱势格局。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多重压力。从技术因子统计来看，十五个因子中有九个发出做空信号，占比百分之六十，五个发出做多信号，占比百分之三十三点三三，一个保持中性。综合指标显示做空信号的历史胜率为百分之七十三点八一，虽然低于BTC的百分之八十，但仍表明空头占据优势。

资金层面，大型鲸鱼账户的去风险化操作对市场造成了显著冲击。在两小时内录得超过一亿美元的净流出，导致价格从两千三百六十七美元快速下跌至两千三百零六美元。这种大额资金的集中撤离不仅直接打压价格，还会引发其他投资者的恐慌性抛售。

生态层面的负面消息同样不容忽视。Glamsterdam测试网的推迟部署打击了市场对以太坊升级进程的的信心。该测试网原计划验证EIP-8037和EIP-8038两个重要的Gas计算改进，但因技术缺陷被迫延期。虽然这不会影响主网运行，但延缓了以太坊向更高效、更廉价交易迈进的步伐。

DeFi安全事件也加剧了市场担忧。X100协议遭遇治理攻击，攻击者利用闪电贷获取两个参议院席位，随后通过操纵代币价格盗取了约四百八十五万美元的USDT。这一事件暴露了链上治理机制的潜在漏洞，可能影响用户对DeFi协议的信任度。

从积极面来看，Bitmine公司新增了十五万九千七百二十八枚ETH的质押，价值约三点九亿美元，目标是达到以太坊总供应量的百分之五。这种机构级别的质押行为为市场提供了一定的底部支撑，限制了价格的进一步下跌空间。

综合来看，以太坊短期内可能继续在两千三百美元至两千四百美元区间震荡。突破两千四百美元需要强劲的基本面支撑和资金流入，而跌破两千三百美元则可能引发更深层次的调整。投资者应密切关注测试网进展、ETF资金流向以及DeFi安全状况，谨慎评估风险收益比。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What does the candlestick you FOMO into usually look like?
translatedData.subTitle:
When a coin shoots up in one huge bullish candle, everyone in the group chat is yelling, “Buy!” Your hand twitches and you chase in—only to find yourself buying at
the top. This scene plays out every day.

Look closely at that big bullish candle that gets your heart racing: people who are already fully invested want you to chase it and buy from them.
After a sharp, high-volume rally, chasing in is essentially providing liquidity to those who were holding before you.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback comes on lower volume and stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself a tuition bill. The market always
gives you a second chance, but it won’t give you your principal back a second time.

What exactly are gas fees?
After Ethereum’s 2021 London upgrade (EIP-1559), gas fees were split into two parts: a base fee and a tip. The base fee is burned.
Gas fees depend mainly on network congestion: each block can hold only a limited number of transactions, and as demand increases, the base fee automatically rises.
$ETH  is the native currency used to pay gas fees on the Ethereum mainnet.

#ETH

content:
Gas 费究竟是怎么回事？
2021 年伦敦升级（EIP-1559）之后，以太坊的 Gas 费拆成基础费和小费两部分，基础费会被销毁。
Gas 费高低主要看网络拥堵程度：每个区块能装的交易是有限的，需求越大，基本费用会自动抬高。
$ETH 是以太坊主网结算 Gas 的原生币。

Geth subscription buffer fix awaiting review｜Impact on data service stability｜Don’t chase ETH before it breaks 2,381

I view client engineering progress as a long-term reliability signal, not as news of a price pump within fifteen minutes. After scanning the Binance Square trending topics, I saw rising interest in South Korean taxes, the Electrum wallet, and stablecoin foreign-exchange regulation. I’ve just assessed the first two independently, and the third is not the most directly relevant new fact for ETH this time around. So this post focuses on a new proposal in Ethereum’s official codebase. Go Ethereum’s RPC proposal 36011 was opened on October 24. It notes that buffered notifications already sent when a subscription is activated are still held by the notifier, so the associated payloads may continue to occupy memory as long as the subscription handler remains active. The submitter proposes clearing the buffer after a successful send and adding regression tests with 1, 10, and 100 notifications at startup. Their local benchmarks show that retained payload references can grow from tens of KB to several MB, while the fix prevents them from being retained. Note that these are the submitter’s test results, not measured evidence of increased mainnet capacity. The page still shows the proposal as open, awaiting review by code owners, and not deployed.

Why should traders care? Nodes and RPC services are foundational infrastructure for wallets, trading front ends, and on-chain data providers. If subscriptions occupy unnecessary memory over long periods, operating costs and stability under high concurrency could be affected. Reducing this kind of friction could improve the user experience, but several steps separate it from ETH demand, fee revenue, and price appreciation. It must first pass review and be merged, then be released in a version, followed by node upgrades and validation under real-world loads. A PR awaiting review should not be treated as a network upgrade already in effect, much less as proof that ETH is about to become deflationary. The Ethereum Foundation’s public notice about the Hoodi testnet upgrade still says it has been postponed, with no new activation date, which is another reminder not to present development activity as a completed deployment. As for ETFs, the Farside ETH table for October 23 has blank product data, so I won’t treat the positive figure from an automatic total as complete institutional net inflows.

I’ll record the market reaction based on observable quotes: at the time of writing, the latest Kraken ETH/USD trade was around $2,346, with a 24-hour high of about $2,381 and a low of about $2,280. The price has rebounded to the middle of the range, but has yet to prove it can break above the high. I see no direct causal link between this code proposal and this price movement. 2,381 is the resistance level to confirm a breakout above, while 2,280 is the current range’s lower bound. If the price falls below 2,280 and fails to reclaim it, my short-term recovery thesis is invalidated. Next, I’ll be watching mainnet node versions, actual subscription memory metrics, and on-chain activity—not just the PR title.

If I were trading this myself, I’d sit out for now. The only direction I’d consider is a small spot long after confirmation, with a planned position size of 1.5% of total capital. The entry trigger is a four-hour close above $2,385, followed by a retest in the next four-hour candle that holds above $2,381. The first target is $2,450, where I’d reduce the position by half; the second target is $2,520, where I’d close the remainder in stages. I’d set a hard stop at $2,320 and exit immediately if it is hit, without adding to the position to average down. I’d also exit proactively if the price hasn’t tested $2,450 within 24 hours of entry, or if a new official notice of a mainnet incident is issued. If the price first breaks below $2,280, I’d cancel the long setup and stay on the sidelines rather than use maintenance work as a reason to catch a falling knife. These are all conditions, not a recap of trades already executed or profits already made.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
Geth订阅缓冲修复待审｜影响数据服务稳定性｜ETH未破2381先不追

我的态度是把客户端工程进展看成长期可靠性线索，而不是十五分钟内的拉盘消息。扫描币安广场热榜后，韩国税务、Electrum钱包、稳定币外汇监管都在升温，但前两项刚做过独立判断，第三项也不是本轮ETH最直接的新增事实；这次聚焦以太坊官方代码库的一项新提案。Go Ethereum的RPC提案36011于10月24日开放，指出订阅激活时已发送的缓冲通知仍被通知器持有，只要订阅处理器存活，相关负载就可能继续占用内存。提交者拟在成功发送后清空缓冲，并加入启动时1、10、100条通知的回归测试；其本地基准显示保留的负载引用可从数十KB扩展至数MB，修复后不再保留。注意这是提交者的测试结果，不是主网容量提升的实测结论；页面仍显示开放、等待代码所有者审查、没有部署。

为什么值得交易员看？节点和RPC服务是钱包、交易前端、链上数据商的基础设施。若订阅长期占用不必要内存，运营成本与高并发稳定性可能受到影响；减少这种摩擦有利于使用体验，但距离ETH需求、手续费收入和币价上涨还有多道传导。必须先经过审查合并、版本发布、节点升级和真实负载验证，不能把一个待审PR当作已经生效的网络升级，更不能推导出ETH马上通缩。以太坊基金会对Hoodi测试网升级的公开通知仍是延期、尚无新激活日期，这也提醒我不要把开发活动误写成既成部署。ETF方面，Farside 10月23日ETH表有产品数据空栏，我不拿自动合计的正数当作完整机构净流入。

市场反应按可见报价记录：写稿时Kraken ETH/USD最近成交约2346美元，24小时高点约2381、低点约2280。价格反弹到了区间中部，却还没证明能够越过高点；我看不出本次代码提案与这段波动有直接因果。2381是确认上沿，2280是当前区间下沿；如果价格跌破2280且无法收复，我对短线修复的判断失效。后续还要看主网节点版本、实际订阅内存指标和链上活跃度，而不是只看PR标题。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑确认后的现货轻仓多头，计划仓位占总资金1.5%。入场触发是四小时收盘高于2385美元，并在下一根四小时K线回踩仍守住2381；第一目标2450，到达时减仓一半，第二目标2520，余仓分批平仓。硬止损放在2320，触及即平仓，不补仓摊低成本；若入场后二十四小时仍未上探2450，或主网出现新的官方故障公告，也主动平仓。若先跌破2280，则取消多头方案、保持观望，不把技术维护当作逆势接刀的理由。这些都是条件，不是已经成交或盈利的复盘。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Hold a Losing Position, Your Brain Is Deceiving You
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% look at? The all-time high. They tell themselves, “If it just gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” But notice: this thought is all attachment and no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you’re stuck holding a losing position, you automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple in theory, but hard to put into practice: before entering a trade, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
will no longer hold,” then follow through when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from your position, and only then can you see clearly

II. In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Dual Pressure from Upgrade Delays and Capital Outflows

As of October 25, 2026, Beijing time, the Ethereum market is facing the combined impact of multiple bearish factors. ETH is currently priced at $2,358.45, down approximately 1.06% over the past 24 hours, after briefly dipping to an intraday low of $2,306. Under the dual pressure of delayed technical upgrades and institutional capital withdrawals, Ethereum’s short-term outlook is not optimistic.

I. Price Trend Analysis

Hourly candlestick data shows that Ethereum began weakening from around $2,368, falling steadily to $2,347 before finding support near $2,350 and staging a slight rebound. The price is currently consolidating in the $2,350–$2,360 range, with trading volume picking up, indicating growing disagreement between buyers and sellers in this area.

In terms of moving averages, the 7-period MA is at $2,360, the 25-period MA at $2,354, and the 99-period MA at $2,406. The price has fallen below all short- and medium-term moving averages, while the 99-period MA is clearly acting as resistance. The exponential moving averages are also bearishly aligned: the 7-period EMA is at $2,356, the 25-period EMA at $2,359, and the 99-period EMA at $2,390. The price is trading below all the EMAs, indicating a bearish short-term trend.

The Bollinger Bands show the upper band at $2,384, the middle band at $2,349, and the lower band at $2,314. The price is currently trading above the middle band, but remains some distance from the upper band, indicating a lack of upward momentum.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The 6-period RSI has quickly retreated from a high of 68.5 to 41.35, while the 12-period RSI has fallen to 44.86 and the 24-period RSI remains at 43.98. All three RSI lines are in neutral-to-weak territory, and the 6-period RSI is nearing oversold territory, suggesting the possibility of a short-term technical rebound.

The MACD is below the zero line, with a current MACD value of -3.82, a signal line of -6.72, and a histogram reading of 2.90. Although the histogram is gradually shrinking, indicating that downward momentum has eased somewhat, the MACD remains broadly bearish. It will be important to watch whether the MACD forms a bullish crossover below the zero line, as this would be a significant signal of a short-term trend reversal.

The KDJ indicator is showing a clear bearish signal: the K line has rapidly fallen from 86.5 to 60.6, the D line remains at 73.6, and the J line has dropped to 34.5. The three KDJ lines are bearishly aligned, and the J line has entered oversold territory, suggesting a potential need for a short-term technical rebound.

The Williams %R (WR) has quickly deteriorated from -3.69 to -37.57, indicating that the price has retreated from overbought territory into a neutral-to-weak range. The Stochastic RSI has also fallen from a high of 100 to 77.3, confirming the loss of short-term momentum.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

The biggest bearish factor currently facing Ethereum is the indefinite delay of the Glamsterdam hard fork. The upgrade was suspended on the Hoodi testnet due to a smart contract gas attack vulnerability, seriously undermining market confidence in Ethereum’s technical progress. The delay means that progress in improving Ethereum’s scalability and performance has slowed, potentially affecting its competitiveness in areas such as DeFi and NFTs.

Institutional selling has also negatively affected market sentiment. Citing macroeconomic risks, BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes sold various crypto assets, including Ethereum, worth approximately $28.8 million in total. The market interpreted this move as a sign that industry insiders are pessimistic about the short-term outlook, further intensifying selling pressure.

In addition, the $4.85 million governance attack on the X100 protocol has negatively affected confidence in DeFi security across the Ethereum ecosystem. The attacker used flash loans to gain governance power, then passed a malicious proposal to steal funds. The incident exposed potential flaws in on-chain governance design, dampening investors’ risk appetite.

On the positive side, Bitmine added 159,728 ETH to its staked holdings, bringing its total to 5.23 million ETH. Ethereum’s total staked amount has now reached 36% of its total supply. This indicates that long-term holders continue to increase their staking positions, providing some underlying support for the price.

Overall, Ethereum will continue to face the dual pressure of delayed technical upgrades and capital outflows in the short term. Whether the $2,350 level holds will be a key focus for the market. If this support is decisively broken, the price could fall further to the lower Bollinger Band at $2,314. Conversely, if the price stabilizes in the current range and rebounds on increased volume, it could make another attempt to break above resistance at $2,400.

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标方面，6周期RSI从68.5的高位快速回落至41.35，12周期RSI降至44.86，24周期RSI维持在43.98。三条RSI线均处于中性偏弱区域，且6周期RSI已经接近超卖区域，短期内存在技术性反弹的可能。

KDJ指标出现了明显的看跌信号，K线从86.5快速下滑至60.6，D线维持在73.6，J线跌至34.5。KDJ三线呈现空头排列，且J线已经进入超卖区域，短期内存在技术性反弹的需求。

威廉指标WR从负3.69快速恶化至负37.57，显示价格已经从上方的超买区域回落至中性偏弱位置。随机RSI指标也从100的高位回落至77.3，确认了短期动能的衰减。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的最大利空因素是Glamsterdam硬分叉升级的无限期延迟。该升级在Hoodi测试网上因智能合约Gas攻击漏洞而被暂停，这一消息严重打击了市场对以太坊技术进展的信心。升级延迟意味着以太坊在可扩展性和性能提升方面的进展放缓，可能影响其在DeFi和NFT等领域的竞争力。

机构层面的抛售也对市场情绪造成了负面影响。BitMEX联合创始人Arthur Hayes以宏观经济风险为由，抛售了包括以太坊在内的多种加密资产，总价值约2880万美元。这一举动被市场解读为行业内人士对短期前景的悲观预期，进一步加剧了抛售压力。

此外，X100协议遭受的485万美元治理攻击事件也对以太坊生态的DeFi安全造成了负面影响。攻击者利用闪电贷获取治理席位，然后执行恶意提案盗取资金，这一事件暴露了链上治理设计的潜在漏洞， dampened了投资者的风险偏好。

不过，从积极的一面来看，Bitmine增加了159728枚ETH的质押量，使其总质押量达到523万枚ETH。目前以太坊总质押量已达到总供应量的百分之三十六，这一数据表明长期持有者仍在持续增加质押，为价格提供了一定的底部支撑。

综合来看，以太坊短期内仍将面临技术升级延迟和资金外流的双重压力，2350美元关口的得失将成为市场关注焦点。如果该支撑位被有效跌破，价格可能进一步下探至2314美元的布林带下轨。反之，若能在当前区域企稳并放量反弹，则有望重新挑战2400美元上方的阻力。

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

Plenty of people are calling this a “long-term value zone,” but seven days ago I predicted “weak consolidation, with sentiment breaking down first.” In reality, ETH fell just 2.5% over the past seven days, while the FGI rose from a weekly average of 57 to 54, and trading volume remained active. The direction hasn’t emerged, which means I underestimated sentiment’s resilience; I was only half right about the consolidation. My mistake was treating “it hasn’t fallen much” as “the risk isn’t high.”

After unauthorized minting and asset transfers, Initia paused its L1 and rollup; more than $2.6 million flowed to Ethereum. Following an attack on the Cysic bridge, the attacker made off with $744,000 in ETH and BNB and laundered the funds through Tornado. In practice, users, bridges, and project teams are the ones affected. Funds flowing into Ethereum don’t necessarily benefit ETH; selling pressure, reputational damage, and regulatory pressure could all be passed along. Simply saying “it’s good for on-chain adoption” doesn’t add up commercially. Security, insurance, and compensation are the real needs.

Next week, I’ll be watching whether 2,241 holds, whether there’s volume above 2,428, and whether the FGI can stay above 50. If volume rises but sentiment doesn’t follow, that often signals a relay. A bottom formed on declining volume isn’t necessarily bad either. I’ll let the market decide the direction.

My view hasn’t changed this week—ETH isn’t short on stories; what’s missing is proof that those stories can become a business. The market hasn’t forced me to change my tune yet, either. Are you willing to buy here, or are you talking value while keeping your hand hovering over the button?

#ETH #加密市场 #HYPE #MarketFeel

subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Through Risk, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Compounding positions has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, then compound several times over
to multiply your money dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about the part they don’t tell you.

Instead of cashing out paper profits, you treat them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It’s like using the market’s money to increase your leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, your paper gains can
go from dozens of percentage points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

[The mathematical truth] The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of winning four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind the overnight-doubling posts you see are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

translatedData.content:
ETH | Geth discussion: asynchronous build for inclusion-list blocks | Review the code first, then watch $2,340 support

My stance is to watch cautiously, not to trade an anti-censorship proposal still in development as if it were an already delivered benefit. On October 24, a change that remains open appeared in Geth, Ethereum’s execution client public code repository: for block payloads containing inclusion-list transactions, it moves the initial build into an asynchronous process, avoiding the need to finish all execution work before obtaining a payload ID. The contributor noted that the current implementation may not respond until after the proposal deadline, leaving the consensus client with an outdated ID; the change also aims to ensure that waiting for a result does not block the queue for updating IDs. This is an engineering fix awaiting review, depends on another change that has yet to be merged, and should not be described as a completed mainnet upgrade—much less as a reason fees will immediately fall today.

Why is this worth tracking? EIP-7805 is still marked as a draft. Its goal is for validator committees to provide transaction inclusion lists, with fork choice constraining block proposers to process them according to the rules, thereby strengthening the guarantee that transactions are included promptly. If a mechanism slows critical timing during payload construction, that can affect its real-world usability. How clients handle latency and concurrency is therefore closer to the threshold for deployment than the hype around conceptual slogans. But the current pull request page also states that only some local tests have passed; development-network tests, full consensus and execution specification tests, and the upstream platform matrix have not yet been completed, while automated checks are still awaiting maintainer approval. My conclusion goes no further than “an engineering issue is being identified and fixed”—not “anti-censorship capabilities are now live.”

The market reaction should also be assessed in layers. At around 13:55 Beijing time, ETH/USD on Kraken was trading at about $2,348, with a 24-hour high and low of roughly $2,381 and $2,280, and an opening price of about $2,356. The current price is slightly below the open, which does not support attributing a rise in ETH’s price directly to this code change. In the short term, I see $2,380 as the confirmation zone above, $2,340 as nearby support, and $2,280 as a deeper level of support. These are reference levels based on the range at the time, not price targets issued by the project. If the code review fails, the dependent change remains unmerged for too long, or the price falls below $2,280 and fails to recover, I should withdraw my view that “engineering progress is supporting sentiment.”

If I were trading this myself, I would not chase a long position or make a high-leverage bet at this point. I would consider cautiously testing a spot long with no more than 5% of my total capital only if the price regains and holds above $2,380 and there is substantive progress in the subsequent official review and testing. After entry, I would first watch $2,420, take half off the position if it reaches that level, and then watch $2,460. I would set a stop-loss below $2,340, and close the remaining position unconditionally if the price breaks below $2,280. If these conditions are never met, I would stay out of the market rather than mistake watching for trading. Engineering news offers a medium-term signal that still needs validation; near-term trading remains governed by price and risk limits.

Sources: Geth public pull request 36014, EIP-7805 draft, and Kraken ETH/USD live quotes. #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH｜Geth讨论包含清单异步构建｜先看代码审查，再看2340美元支撑

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把开发中的抗审查方案直接交易成已经兑现的利好。10月24日，以太坊执行客户端 Geth 的公开代码库出现一项仍处于开放状态的改动：针对包含清单交易的区块载荷，把初始构建移到异步流程，避免在取得载荷编号前完成全部执行工作。提交者写明，现有实现可能拖到提议时间之后才回复，令共识客户端拿到旧编号；改动还希望让等待结果的过程不堵住更新编号的队列。这是待审查的工程修复，依赖另一项尚待合并的改动，不能写成主网升级完成，更不能推导为今天的手续费立刻下降。

它为什么值得跟踪？EIP-7805 仍标为草案，目标是让验证者委员会提供交易包含清单，并由分叉选择约束出块方按规则处理，以增强交易被及时纳入的保障。一个机制如果在构建载荷时拖慢关键时序，就会影响实际可用性；因此客户端对延迟和并发的处理，比热闹的概念口号更接近落地门槛。但本次提交页面也明确：部分本地测试通过，开发网、完整共识与执行规范测试以及上游平台矩阵尚未跑完，自动化检查还等维护者批准。我的判断只停留在“工程问题正在被识别和修补”，绝不是“抗审查能力已经上线”。

市场反应也应分层看。北京时间13:55左右，Kraken 的 ETH/USD 约2348美元，过去24小时高低约2381与2280美元，开盘约2356美元；现价略低于该开盘，不支持把这项代码提交说成推动币价上涨的直接原因。短线我把2380美元视为上方确认区，2340美元视为就近支撑，2280美元视为更深一层防守；这些是根据当时区间设定的观察位，不是项目给出的目标价。若代码审查未通过、依赖改动迟迟无法合并，或价格跌破2280美元后无法收回，我对“工程进展支撑情绪”的判断就应撤回。

如果是我自己交易，我目前不追多，也不做高杠杆押注；只在价格重新站稳2380美元且后续官方审查与测试有实质进展时，考虑用总资金不超过5%试探现货多头。入场后先看2420美元，触及后减仓一半，再看2460美元；跌回2340美元下方止损，若跌破2280美元则无条件清掉剩余仓位。若条件始终不触发，就保持空仓，不把观察当成交。工程新闻提供的是待验证的中期线索，眼前交易仍由价格与风险预算决定。

来源：Geth 公开提交 PR 36014、EIP-7805 草案、Kraken ETH/USD 即时报价。#ETH

This has changed how I view ETH: it’s not simply a question of whether the price will rise or fall, but of who’s willing to put real funds, users, and businesses on the network. Incidents like Initia’s directly affect users, cross-chain projects, and long-term investors. A single vulnerability means the ecosystem bears the costs of fixes, audits, and migrations. The business case doesn’t add up unless security, compensation mechanisms, and emergency response capabilities are strong enough.

October 25 Weekend: ETH Weekly Recap
 
ETH saw a volatile recovery this week following a sharp sell-off. The cycle low occurred late on October 24, between 11 p.m. and midnight. U.S. stock markets were closed on Saturday and Sunday, so the sell-off was not driven by the U.S. session opening. This time window typically sees relatively thin local liquidity in crypto markets. With a shallow order book, even a small number of sell orders can trigger a panic wick. ETH briefly fell to 2281.22. After selling pressure eased, buyers stepped in and the price gradually recovered. It is currently fluctuating around 2365.
 
On the 4-hour chart, the rebound after the sharp drop looks like a recovery following the release of panic-driven selling. The short-term price has moved above the short-term moving averages, and sentiment has improved in the near term, but the broader structure remains weak. The key reason behind this early sell-off was that investors priced in uncertainty around next week's FOMC meeting ahead of time. They reduced positions to limit risk before the major rate decision, driving prices to a panic low. Once panic selling had cleared, some investors chose to position themselves ahead of the meeting, leading to this rebound.
 
In my view, this is currently just a recovery bounce ahead of the FOMC meeting, not a trend reversal. The first resistance zone above is the previous consolidation area at 2410–2420. If the rebound meets resistance there, ETH may pull back again to test support. The short-term dividing line between strength and weakness is 2330. Holding above it would keep the short-term structure range-bound with a bullish bias. If it breaks below, sellers may step in again and test the previous low.
 
The biggest driver for the rest of the week remains the FOMC meeting. The market broadly expects rates to remain unchanged this time. The main focus is on what the Fed says about whether it will continue raising rates in December. If its tone is hawkish, U.S. Treasury yields and the dollar could strengthen, putting renewed pressure on ETH and the broader crypto market. If the wording is dovish and eases expectations of a December rate hike, risk assets could have a chance to stage a larger rebound.
 
From a trading perspective, false breakouts and whipsaw moves are likely to be frequent before the meeting, so chasing trades with large positions is not advisable. The preferred approach is to treat the market as range-bound: don't chase sharp rallies or panic blindly during sharp drops. Wait until the decision is announced and the direction of capital flows becomes clearer before making plans. Be sure to reduce leverage, as news-driven markets carry a high risk of sudden price wicks.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling In: How to Add to a Winning Trend Trade Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position. How should you do it? Going all in from the start and adding until you’re fully loaded with unrealized gains is a surefire way to end up on the liquidation list.
A common sight. The right approach is called pyramid scaling in.

【The principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After another confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, all your trades go off course.

هذه أهم نقطة في التحليل:

ماذا يعني هذا عملياً؟

نتيجة: لا تنتظر انفجار SOL قبل استقرار BTC.

• دعم فوري: 100.53$ • مقاومة فورية: 104.44$ • مؤشر RSI: 36.4، أي منطقة قريبة من التشبع البيعي لكن لم تصل للانعكاس بعد

SOL حالياً ليست عملة مستقلة في الحركة، بل هي نسخة عالية البيتا من BTC. تتحرك معه صعوداً وهبوطاً، لكن بحدة أكبر.

【A week without movement—what is ETH waiting for?】

ETH is around $2,341 today. Working backward from its 7-day change of -1.5%, it was about $2,377 a week ago. I didn’t note the price a month ago, so I won’t pretend I know. What I can confirm: it’s down 52.7% from its high, up 2% over 24 hours, and trading volume is low.

These past few days, I’ve been watching not whether prices rise or fall, but why they can’t seem to gain ground. It’s in the green over 24 hours but still in the red over 7 days, and volume isn’t cooperating. The market is waiting for a reason to change its expectations. I used to think a steep drop alone made an asset worth watching for the long term. Now I see that value doesn’t mean capital will come in right away—the missing piece is a viable business model.

Initia paused its L1 and rollups because of a vulnerability, and more than $2.6 million in assets were moved to Ethereum. In practical terms, security isn’t a feature; it’s a prerequisite for users to be able to access their assets. Users, developers, LPs, and projects that depend on the chain are all affected. The business logic is simple: a single incident can raise the cost of migrating, and trust is the most expensive product infrastructure has to offer. ETH received the funds, but treating someone else’s misfortune as a positive for ETH doesn’t add up.

So here’s what I’m stuck on: what will keep attracting capital and developers to ETH? If fees, revenue, and application growth don’t follow, a stable narrative may support its valuation, but it can’t kick off a new cycle. I haven’t fully figured it out, and I don’t dare predict which way things will go.

What matters more to you: rising ETH trading volume, on-chain revenue, or capital moving after security incidents?

今天的ETH约2341美元，按7日-1.5%倒推，一周前约2377；一个月前我没记价，不装懂。能确认的是，距高点回撤52.7%，24小时涨2%，成交量偏低。

Guys, this is something you really need to understand: the Cancun upgrade and blobs!
When the Cancun upgrade went live, the target was 3 blobs per block, with a maximum of 6; the Pectra upgrade in May 2025 raised that to a target of 6 and a maximum of 9.
Blobs are cheap because blob data is kept for only about 18 days, rather than stored permanently, and isn’t used in EVM computation, which means a much lighter burden on nodes.
When Layer 2 networks submit blob data to the mainnet, they also pay blob fees in $ETH .
Save this and take your time reading

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where should you place a stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too tight, and you get stopped out every day; too wide, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right where other traders’ stops are clustered.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss】Place it where the market structure would be invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if price breaks this level, that’s evidence I was wrong.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, we’ll look at how to use them as an emotional barometer.

[State 1: Funding rates stay strongly positive] This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often in the accelerating, topping-out phase, and a sharp drop from a “long squeeze” could happen at any time. This doesn’t mean you should immediately
This doesn’t mean you should short right away. Rather, be extra cautious about going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often occur near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to exit has already left, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past have started in situations like this.

subTitle:
10月25日 深夜盘 10币全景：全线收红却12小时没涨，这波缩量反弹成色不足

【一句话定调】
10 个主流币 24h 全部收红，但把镜头拉近到最近 12 小时，**10 个币无一例外全在回落**。涨幅是白天就完成的，晚上只是在原地磨。加上成交量普遍只有 7 日均量的三成不到，这更像空头回补的余温，不是新资金进场。

【大盘：$BTC】
现价 80,683，24h +1.39%，但 4 小时只有 +0.13%、12 小时 −0.22%——上涨发生在 12 小时之前，此后价格基本横住。
· 均线：MA7 81,891、MA25 82,955，价格仍在 MA25 下方 2.74%，空头排列没修复
· 动能：RSI14 43.5，处于弱势修复区；MACD 柱 −312 仍在零轴下方，没有金叉迹象
· 位置：布林带内 14% 位置，贴着下轨走；30 日区间 18.3% 分位
· 波动：ATR 2.64%，日内理论波幅约 2,130 美元
· 量能：24h 成交额 5.26 亿美元，仅为 7 日均量的 **0.26 倍**
关键位看三档：上方 81,891（MA7）是反弹第一道坎；中间 79,523 是 24h 低点；下方 79,221 是 30 日低点，这条线破了就是新一轮下探。价格现在夹在布林下轨附近，属于典型的弱势整理。

【二线梯队：$ETH SOL XRP】
ETH 2,346，24h +2.10%，但 RSI 只有 35.3，是十币中最弱之一。价格低于 MA25（2,505）达 6.35%，30 日分位 12.9%，距 30 日高点 2,777 还有 15.5% 的坑。以太坊的相对弱势这一轮始终没改善。
SOL 101.66，24h +2.31%，MA25 在 109.59，价格低了 7.24%。100 整数关口与 24h 低点 99.25 几乎重合，30 日低点 98.62 就在下方，这里是多头必须守住的位置。
XRP 1.3012，24h +2.98%，是今天涨幅第二的品种，RSI 39.9 也相对健康。但 24h 高点 1.3159 已经摸到又被打回，说明 1.31 上方有实盘抛压；MA25 在 1.38，距离仍远。

【平台与支付：$BNB TON】
BNB 742.26，24h +3.10%，是十币里唯一「三好学生」：价格站上 MA7（739.04）、MACD 柱 +0.46 是唯一正值、布林带 53.3% 已回到中轨上方，RSI 49.8 接近中性。成交量更是 7 日均量的 0.61 倍，明显比大盘活跃。结构最健康，若大盘企稳，BNB 大概率第一个修复。
TON 1.600，24h +0.95%，但 4 小时 −0.99%，是**唯一 4h 转弱的品种**。价格虽在 MA7（1.581）上方，但成交量只有 7 日均量的 **0.05 倍**，几乎没人交易，流动性风险要留意。MA25 在 1.646，是反弹必须收复的位置。

【高弹性尾部：DOGE ADA AVAX LINK】
这一档的共同特征是：30 日分位全在 10% 以下，跌幅最深，波动最大。
· DOGE 0.0773，24h +2.57%，RSI 34.2 已在超卖边缘，30 日低点 0.0748 是最后防线
· ADA 0.2059，24h +1.88%，低于 MA25 达 12.23%，30 日分位 6.6%，距 30 日高点 0.2824 已跌去 27%
· AVAX 8.91，24h +1.76%，ATR 6.57% 为十币最高，30 日低点 8.675 就在脚下
· LINK 11.439，24h +0.92% 涨幅垫底，布林带位置仅 7.2%——几乎贴着下轨爬行，30 日分位 5.2% 是全场最低
共性很明确：RSI 全部落在 34~36 的超卖边缘，ATR 普遍 5%~6.6%。这类品种反弹时弹性最大，但破位下杀同样最狠，不适合重仓过夜。

【盘面主线】
1. 时间错配是最大警示。24h 全红、12h 全绿，说明这波反弹是「白天的事」。夜间无人接力，往往意味着亚洲时段开盘后容易回吐。
2. 量能塌陷。BTC 0.26 倍、TON 0.05 倍、AVAX 0.27 倍，全场只有 BNB（0.61 倍）还算有量。缩量上涨靠的是卖盘消失，不是买盘涌入。
3. 结构分化在加剧。BNB 已站在中轨上方，而 LINK、ADA 还趴在 30 日区间 5%~7% 分位。资金在向头部和平台币集中，尾部品种正在被抛弃。
4. 中期跌幅没有修复。除 BNB 外，多数币距 30 日高点还有 15%~30% 的空间，这是下跌趋势中的反抽形态，不是底部反转。

【操作参考】
· 短线：BTC 79,500~80,000 区间若出现放量止跌，可轻仓博反弹，止损放在 79,221（30 日低点）下方，第一目标 81,891（MA7）。
· 中线：均线空头排列未破之前，把反弹当减仓机会而不是加仓机会。等价格站上 MA25（82,955）再谈趋势。
· 相对强弱：BNB 是目前唯一值得优先关注的标的，回调到 719（24h 低点）附近的风险收益比好于追高。
· 关键观察点：亚洲时段能否放量。不放量的任何上涨，都是给套牢盘提供出逃流动性。

【风险提示】
以上内容基于币安公开行情数据的技术面客观梳理，不构成任何投资建议。加密货币波动剧烈，杠杆会放大亏损，请独立判断并严格控制仓位。

What is a blob, and why does it lower Layer 2 fees?
Blob data is stored only by consensus-layer nodes for about 4096 epochs, or roughly 18 days, after which it is deleted.
EIP-4844 introduced a new type of transaction that carries blobs. Each blob contains 4096 data units of 32 bytes each, or about 128 KB.
When managing funds, the most important thing to keep in mind is to distinguish between a Layer 2 network’s own execution fees and the cost of submitting data to the mainnet when comparing Layer 2 network fees. Both costs can fluctuate.
