📰 SK Hynix overtakes Intel in chip revenue rankings—why is demand for AI memory changing the game?

SK Hynix recently overtook Intel to become the world’s leading chipmaker by revenue. This is mainly because AI development requires large amounts of specialized memory, and SK Hynix has done particularly well in memory designed for AI. It is now making more money than the longstanding chip giant Intel. This has had a major impact on the overall chip industry landscape and has drawn market attention to companies specializing in chips and memory designed for AI.

Why does this news matter?
The fundamental reason SK Hynix was able to overtake Intel is that the AI industry’s growth requires large amounts of specialized memory. Traditional memory, such as DDR4, is not efficient enough for AI computing, so memory specifically designed for AI—such as HBM (high-bandwidth memory)—is needed. SK Hynix leads in HBM production capacity and technology, allowing it to benefit from the AI boom. In terms of the industry cycle, this signals that the market is shifting away from traditional computing chips toward AI-specific chips, with capital and resources flowing in that direction. In connection with other recent developments, Intel is also increasing its investment in AI chips, but SK Hynix has already gained an advantage through its memory technology.

Impact on the market
SK Hynix’s revenue growth could drive gains in AI chip and memory stocks, benefiting companies that are also investing in AI. Although this news is not directly about cryptocurrency, the development of AI technology could boost the broader tech industry. BTC and ETH, as stores of value and digital gold, often benefit when technology stocks rise. 💡 Growing demand for AI memory could drive gains in the technology sector and BTC/ETH, but how long this trend lasts depends on how quickly AI technology is put to practical use. If real-world AI applications fail to keep pace with expectations, this thesis could be disproven.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Staggered profit-taking: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the staggered profit-taking approach I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: when it reaches the first target (e.g. a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell 1/3 to lock in some gains,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage two: when it reaches the second target
(e.g. a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another 1/3. Stage three: let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you exit the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up right back where you started.

Geth Estimation Fix Proposal | Ethereum Mainnet Unaffected | ETH Must Hold 2,370 Before Considering an Entry

My stance is to keep watching. I’m not going to turn a proposed fix to a developer tool into an Ethereum mainnet outage. On October 25, a PR, #36017, was opened in the go-ethereum project to address how eth_estimateGas handles blockOverrides.prevRandao. The proposal explains that on chains where the block-header difficulty is nonzero, the estimator may fail to pass the overridden randomness value when rebuilding the execution context, causing its estimates to differ from calls such as eth_call and debug_traceCall. Both the original issue, #35913 , and the proposal are clear that the conditions are narrow: Ethereum mainnet’s current difficulty is zero, so it is not affected by this issue. The PR author reported that the reproduction and local tests passed, but the code has not yet been merged, so it would be inaccurate to say the fix is already live.

The main connection to the market is in development and testing. If teams use block override parameters on special test chains to simulate contract branches, estimation discrepancies could affect transaction construction, simulation results, and wallet prompts. This does not directly change mainnet gas fee rules, and there is no evidence that ordinary ETH transfers have failed as a result. Clarifying the scope is more useful than seeing the words “estimation error” and speculating about mainnet congestion. Next, watch for maintainer review, whether the PR is merged, which official release it makes it into, and whether related tools are validated as well. Until those steps are complete, I view this only as an implementation consistency issue awaiting a fix.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, the latest trade on Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,342, with an intraday UTC range of approximately $2,316–$2,368. This quote only shows that the price is still within the range; it does not prove that the market is trading on this PR. Interest in ETH searches on Binance Square has picked up, but that alone does not confirm sustained buying. My key levels are the $2,368–$2,370 upper boundary and the $2,315–$2,320 lower boundary. If price only briefly spikes above the upper boundary before falling back, I’d still consider it range-bound. I’d consider short-term continuation only if price breaks above $2,370 on strong volume and holds that level on a retest. If it falls below $2,315 and fails to reclaim it on a rebound, my bullish view is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter yet. I’d only consider a small spot long if specific conditions are met. I’d use just 2% of my total capital for a test position, with no leverage, and only if the hourly close is above $2,370, the subsequent retest holds, and prices on major exchanges show no significant divergence. The first target is $2,400, where I’d sell half; the second is $2,430, where I’d reduce the rest in stages. After entering, I’d set $2,320 as a hard stop-loss, and close early if the retest fails to hold $2,370 or if a project announcement changes the conditions underlying my view. If the conditions aren’t met, I stay out. I won’t present a plan as an executed trade, and I certainly won’t chase a rally based on a code proposal that has not yet been merged.

Sources: go-ethereum PR #36017, original Issue #35913; price: Kraken ETH/USD. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

Geth估算修正提案｜以太坊主网未受波及｜ETH守住2370再谈参与

我的态度是继续观察，今天不把开发工具的修补提案炒成以太坊主网故障。10月25日，go-ethereum 项目出现一项仍处于 Open 状态的 PR #36017，拟修正 eth_estimateGas 在使用 blockOverrides.prevRandao 时的处理。提案说明，在区块头难度不为零的链上，估算器重建执行上下文时可能没有把覆盖后的随机值传进去，导致估算结果与 eth_call、debug_traceCall 等调用不一致。原始问题 #35913 与提案都把条件说得很窄：以太坊主网当前难度为零，不在这次问题的影响范围内。PR 作者报告了复现测试和本地测试通过，但代码仍未合并，也不能写成已经上线修复。

这件事与市场的联系主要在开发和测试环节。若团队在特殊测试链上用区块覆盖参数模拟合约分支，估算偏差可能影响交易构造、模拟判断及钱包提示；它并没有直接改写主网 Gas 费规则，也没有证据表明普通 ETH 转账因此失败。把范围说清楚，比看到“估算错误”四个字就猜测主网拥堵更有价值。后续要看维护者审阅、是否合并、进入哪个正式版本，以及相关工具是否同步验证。在这些节点未完成前，我只把它视为待处理的实现一致性问题。

title: Особое мнение: Ethereum — 2800 как ближайшая цель, но с последующим откатом
subTitle:
В прогнозе, который недавно появился на Binance Square, вместе с Bitcoin на 90k был назван и Ethereum на 2800 долларов в ближайшей перспективе. После этого — сильный откат. Я разделяю эту логику.
Текущая ситуация
Ethereum сейчас торгуется в районе 2320–2340 долларов. Отсюда до 2800 — это примерно +20%. Рост выглядит вполне реалистичным, особенно если Bitcoin пойдёт тестировать 88–90k. Исторически ETH часто догоняет или даже опережает BTC на отдельных участках бычьего импульса.
При этом Ethereum в последние недели чувствует себя относительно слабее биткоина. Спотовые ETH ETF продолжают показывать более слабые потоки по сравнению с Bitcoin (октябрь для эфирных фондов выглядит заметно хуже). Это создаёт дополнительное давление и объясняет, почему ETH сейчас торгуется с дисконтом к своим предыдущим локальным максимумам.
Почему 2800 выглядит достижимым
Если общий рынок крипты получит хотя бы умеренный позитив (снижение доходностей, улучшение риск-аппетита, или просто технический пробой ключевых уровней у BTC), Ethereum легко может выстрелить к зоне 2700–2800. Это уровень, где сосредоточено достаточно ликвидности и психологически важная отметка.
Однако именно после достижения этой зоны я жду довольно жёсткий откат. Причины те же, что и у Bitcoin:
• Отсутствие устойчивого институционального спроса (судя по ETF-потокам).
• Высокая вероятность фиксации прибыли после локального выноса.
• Общая усталость рынка после предыдущих циклов.
В случае реализации сценария «2800 и разворот» логичной целью отката видится зона 2100–2200, а в более глубоком сценарии — возврат к 1900–2000.
Итог
Ближайшие недели могут дать Ethereum хороший импульс вверх. Но покупать на эмоциях у 2700–2800 я бы не стал. Гораздо интереснее смотреть на возможности после отката.
Это исключительно личное мнение и анализ текущей рыночной ситуации.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are a Blockchain’s Fuel Costs?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay Gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The essence】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running
a contract) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who help execute those computations.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to the price of ETH】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

to the issuer for redemption. This “issuance-redemption” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.

Let’s talk about address poisoning.
Some token contracts allow transfers of 0 tokens. Attackers can exploit this to create a record that looks like tokens were sent from your address, making it seem as though you made the transfer yourself.
One thing that’s easy to overlook: once an on-chain transfer is confirmed, it can’t be reversed. Assets sent to a fake address usually can’t be recovered.
Ignore small transfers from unfamiliar addresses, and never add the sender’s address to your frequently used addresses.
Wallets that frequently transfer stablecoins and $ETH  are more likely to be targeted by address poisoning.

#ETH

content:
聊聊地址投毒。
有的代币合约允许转账金额为 0，攻击者利用这一点能制造出一条“从你的地址转出”的记录，看上去像你自己转过账。
容易被忽略的一点：链上转账只要被确认就无法撤回，转到假地址的资产通常找不回来。
看到陌生地址发来的小额转账不用理会，更不要把对方地址当成常用地址。
经常转账稳定币和 $ETH 的钱包，比较容易被地址投毒盯上。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being Flat Is a Position Too—and It’s the One Experienced Traders Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have is that if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market volatility whittle away their capital.

In reality, being flat is the only position with zero losses. Stay out when you don’t understand the market,
Staying out when bulls and bears are battling it out, and staying out after a string of bad trades—the money you save in these three moments
is more than most traders make from trading.

You may be tired of hunting metaphors, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. You need capital on hand so you have bullets when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your bullets.

Common attack types include reentrancy, oracle manipulation, access control errors, and cross-chain bridge verification flaws. A security audit is an examination of a particular version of the code by a third-party security team at a specific point in time.
Risks are not limited to contract code: oracles, other protocols it depends on, administrative privileges, and a hijacked frontend can all pose problems.
Ethereum, where $ETH  is located, was one of the earliest public blockchains to support general-purpose smart contracts. Currently 2345.8.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own trades. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses…
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeated over and over—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

The market changes, but your behavioral patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade log is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.

【Low-volume ETH is much like the internet-stock era, when markets were waiting for earnings to prove the hype】

Around 2000, at the height of the Nasdaq boom, stories moved faster than profits. Then the bubble burst, and the companies that survived were the ones with real revenue and users. ETH’s market now looks a lot like that period: its price is hovering around $2,338, unchanged over 24 hours and down slightly by 0.4% over seven days. Trading volume is subdued, and everyone is waiting for a direction.

What does this mean in practice, and who will be affected? Does the business logic hold up? The answer is straightforward: in a low-volume consolidation, short-term traders have little advantage. The real pressure falls on altcoins that rely on leverage and low liquidity. Long-term investors, meanwhile, will take another look at whether ETH’s network settlement, applications, and asset issuance can generate real demand. With support at $2,271 and resistance at $2,415, talk of a trend reversal before a breakout doesn’t mean much.

US AI and chip stocks remain the world’s biggest “storehouses” for capital—but even the largest storehouse has to keep its shelves turning over. If the Federal Reserve stays restrictive, high-valuation tech stocks and crypto assets will both face liquidity pressure. If policy shifts toward easing, capital will first return to liquidity anchors like Bitcoin. BTC dominance is at 60%, suggesting investors are still playing defense. For ETH to take the lead, trading volume has to pick up.

AI is no longer just a tool, and neither is blockchain. Hype alone is worthless; only technologies that generate revenue and attract capital can endure.

Do you think ETH is more likely to follow US tech stocks into a rally of its own, or to keep waiting for confirmation from global liquidity?

content:
【低成交的ETH，像极了互联网行情等待业绩验收的阶段】

2000年前后，纳斯达克最热的时候，故事比利润跑得更快；后来泡沫破了，能留下的是真正有收入、有用户的公司。现在ETH的盘面很像那个阶段：价格2338美元附近，24小时没动，7天微跌0.4%，成交量偏低，大家都在等方向。

这件事落到实处意味着什么？谁会因此受影响？商业逻辑通不通？答案很直接：低成交整理时，短线资金没有优势，真正承压的是依赖杠杆和低流动性的山寨资产；长期资金则会重新检查ETH的网络结算、应用和资产发行能不能带来真实需求。支撑2271美元、阻力2415美元，突破前谈趋势反转，意义不大。

美股AI、芯片仍是全球资金最大的“仓库”，但仓库再大，也得看货架周转。美联储若继续偏紧，高估值科技股和加密资产会一起承受流动性压力；若转向宽松，资金先回到比特币这类流动性锚点。BTC占比60%，说明资金还在防守，ETH要接棒，量能必须跟上。

AI已经不是工具了，区块链也一样。喊概念不值钱，能产生收入、沉淀资金的技术才留得住。

截至北京时间十月二十六日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报两千三百五十点二七美元，过去二十四小时小幅上涨百分之零点三三。从小时级别K线来看，ETH在过去五个小时内从两千三百五十七美元逐步回落至两千三百四十美元的低位，整体呈现震荡走弱的格局。

以太坊近期表现明显弱于比特币。过去三十天内ETH累计下跌约百分之十三，而BTC同期跌幅仅约百分之五。价格已跌破七周期和二十五周期均线，九十九周期EMA两千三百七十七美元构成上方强阻力。布林带中轨两千三百四十七美元已被跌破，价格正在向下轨两千三百二十三点一三美元靠近。值得注意的是，以太坊ETF上周净流出超过两亿两千万美元，BlackRock旗下ETHA领跌，机构资金持续撤离。

South Korea Tightens Stablecoin FX Oversight｜ETH Payment Narrative Must Wait for Legislation｜Stay Disciplined Around 2,340

My stance is neutral to cautious: South Korea is moving ahead with cross-border stablecoin oversight, but treating “plans to legislate” as “the law is already in force” and then chasing ETH on that basis conflates developments at different stages. Binance Square’s trending topics are discussing South Korea’s proposal to bring stablecoins under its foreign exchange law framework. This is indeed related to stablecoin use on Ethereum, but it is not an upgrade to the ETH protocol itself, nor does it mean South Korea has banned stablecoins.

First, let’s lay out the verifiable facts. On October 6, South Korea’s Ministry of Economy and Finance announced a draft amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, with public consultation beginning on October 7. The main focus is the definition, registration, and reporting requirements for cross-border virtual asset transfer businesses. The draft covers transfers between domestic and overseas service providers, as well as between service providers and personal wallets, and proposes reporting data to the Bank of Korea’s foreign exchange information system. This is a draft of implementing rules; it should not be described as a new stablecoin payments law that has formally taken effect. Separately, according to media reports on October 23, the Bank of Korea said that it and the government plan to prepare an amendment to the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act before year-end that would explicitly classify stablecoins as payment instruments. As of my research, I have not seen an official text confirming that this new law has completed the legislative process.

I see two sides to the way this could affect ETH: clearer compliance pathways could make licensed institutions more willing to adopt stablecoin settlement, potentially benefiting transfer demand on Ethereum and layer-2 networks. However, registration, reporting, and wallet identification costs could also suppress some cross-border flows. An increase in stablecoin transfer volume does not necessarily mean a corresponding increase in buying demand for ETH, especially since layer-2 fees, issuers’ choice of chain, and where institutions execute transactions all affect how much value accrues to the network. For now, this is only a medium-term factor to watch; it does not directly imply a one-way short-term market move.

Price signals already in the market should also be considered independently. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken is around $2,341, compared with a UTC daily open of around $2,356, and has ranged between $2,316 and $2,368 intraday. The current price is below the open, so today’s movement cannot be attributed to a South Korean bill that has not yet passed. My levels to watch are the intraday low near $2,315 and the intraday high near $2,368. If the price breaks below $2,315 and fails to rebound convincingly, short-term buying support is insufficient. If it moves above $2,368 and holds there, then it may be worth discussing the $2,400 psychological level. I will give this news more weight only if official legislation is finalized and ETH continues to outperform the broader market on rising volume.

If I were trading this myself, I would neither chase a long nor open a short right now; I would stay on the sidelines. I would consider spot ETH only, with a planned position no larger than 5% of total capital. The entry trigger would be a sustained move above $2,368, followed by a retest within the next hour that holds. The initial target would be $2,400, with a second target at $2,440. I would take half off at $2,400, then close most of the remaining position at $2,440. I would place the stop below $2,340, and exit early if, after the stop is triggered, the price falls back below $2,368. If the price breaks below $2,315 first, the entire long plan is invalidated; I would not turn it into a dip-buying trade just because the topic is trending. Position sizing should ensure the stop is affordable, and I would not use leverage. If the official draft changes or the market fails to break through, I will reassess based on the new facts rather than make excuses for my earlier view.

韩国稳定币外汇监管升温｜ETH支付叙事需等法案｜2340附近先守纪律

我的态度是中性偏谨慎：韩国跨境稳定币监管正在推进，但把“计划立法”当成“法律已经落地”，再据此追高ETH，是把不同阶段的消息混在一起。币安广场热榜正在讨论韩国拟把稳定币纳入外汇法框架；这确实与以太坊上的稳定币使用相关，却不是ETH协议本身的升级，更不是韩国已经禁止稳定币。

先把能核实的事实摆清楚。韩国财政经济部10月6日公布《外汇交易法》实施令修订草案，10月7日起征求意见，重点是跨境虚拟资产转移业务的定义、注册及申报。草案涉及本地与海外服务商之间，以及服务商与个人钱包之间的转移，并拟把资料报送韩国央行外汇信息系统。这是一份实施细则草案，不能写成正式生效的新稳定币支付法。另据10月23日媒体转述韩国央行表态，央行与政府打算年内准备将稳定币明确列为支付工具的外汇法修法案；截至我查证时，我没有看到该项新法已完成立法的官方文本。

我看这件事对ETH的传导链条有两面：如果合规路径更清晰，持牌机构接入稳定币结算的意愿可能上升，以太坊及二层网络的转账需求有机会受益；但注册、申报和钱包识别成本也可能压低一部分跨境流量。稳定币转账量增加不等于ETH买盘同步增加，尤其二层费用、发行方选链与机构执行地点都会改变价值回流。因此现在只能把它视作中期观察变量，不能直接推导出短线单边行情。

市场已经给出的价格信号也要独立看。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2341美元，UTC当日开盘约2356，日内在2316至2368美元之间波动；目前价格低于开盘，不能把今天的波动归因于尚未通过的韩国法案。我的观察位是2315附近的当日低点、2368附近的当日高点。若跌破2315且反抽无力，短线买盘承接不足；若站上2368并维持，才有资格讨论2400整数位。只有韩国正式文本明确落地、且ETH相对市场持续放量走强，我才会提高这条消息的权重。

如果是我自己交易：现在不追多、不做空，保持观望；只考虑ETH现货，计划仓位不超过总资金的5%。入场触发是价格站稳2368美元并在随后一小时回踩不破，初步目标2400，第二目标2440；到2400先减半，到2440再减剩余仓位的大部分。止损放在2340下方，若触发后重新跌回2368下方也提前平仓；若先跌破2315，整个做多计划作废，不因热榜热度改成抄底。仓位以能承受止损为前提，不用杠杆。后续若官方草案内容变化或市场拒绝突破，我会按新事实重新评估，而不是替旧判断找理由。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, we can forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them up:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before opening a position. If you can't, don't open one.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three consecutive losses, stop trading for the day. Just watch—don't trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That's it—just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market; it's that their discipline breaks down. Here's to us.

When prices move sharply, liquidations often happen in clusters: the first positions get liquidated, pushing prices further and triggering the next batch.

A quick note: Binance futures liquidations totaled approximately $2.35 million over the past hour. Long positions accounted for 21.9%, and the largest liquidation was $ETH .
People often ask how to interpret liquidation data. Here’s how I understand it.
The amounts reported are based on the notional value of positions, not actual losses. With isolated margin, if a 10x leveraged position is liquidated, the main loss is roughly 10% of the notional value in margin.
Price ranges where liquidations cluster are often later used as short-term support or resistance levels, but whether they hold depends on subsequent buying and selling.
Extreme readings often come with more dramatic price swings. At times like these, it’s better to reduce your position size rather than add to it.

#ETH

content:
记一笔：过去1小时币安合约爆仓合计约 235万美元，多单占 21.9%，居首的是 $ETH 。
总有人问爆仓数据该怎么看，我是这么理解的。
播报里的金额是按仓位名义价值算的，并不是实际亏损：逐仓模式下，10 倍杠杆的仓位被强平，损失的主要是名义价值一成左右的保证金。
强平集中出现的价格区域，之后常常会被当作短线支撑压力的参考，不过能不能起作用要看后续买卖。
极端读数往往伴随更剧烈的振幅，这时候更应该降低仓位，而不是加码。
